name: Shree Rajiv Lochan Oil Extraction Ltd

facts.business: The company is engaged in oil extraction but has not undertaken core business operations during the year, generating income only from investments.

auditor.name: Not specified in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Disclaimer of opinion due to inability to obtain sufficient appropriate audit evidence regarding the appropriateness of management's use of the going concern basis of accounting, as the company disposed of its principal manufacturing plant and has not carried out significant operating activities.

key_risks: Price fluctuations in agro-based raw materials
Economic conditions affecting demand/supply and price conditions in domestic markets
Changes in government regulations, tax laws and other statutes
Going concern uncertainty due to disposal of principal manufacturing plant and cessation of core operations
facts.related_party_note: There are no material transactions with related parties, which require separate disclosure. A comprehensive list of transactions entered into with the related parties as required by the Accounting Standards (AS) 18 is given as a separate Schedule to the accounts in the Annual Report.
